title: Exterior and interior gray color impressions
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly discuss satisfaction with gray exterior shades and some interior color combinations, with one clear complaint about a dark interior color and many fragments too brief to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise Oxide Grey, Brooklyn Grey, Frozen Deep Grey, and two-tone gray combinations as beautiful, compliment-worthy, and enjoyable to look at.

negative.summary: The negative review dislikes the interior color for being too dark.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention color or describe a shade without enough context to confirm a clear evaluation.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are short or vague, so a substantial portion of this topic cannot be assigned clear sentiment.
The examples focus mainly on color preference and appearance, and they do not support broader conclusions beyond those aspects.
One example references a different vehicle name within the fragment text, which limits model-specific interpretation of that fragment.
